blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Sen. Panfilo Lacson said there will be no exceptions as the Senate goes “gung-ho” in scrutinizing questionable allocations in the House-approved version of the 2027 General Appropriations Bill (GAB). Lacson said that the Senate majority backs Senate finance committee chairman Jose Victor “JV” Ejercito’s move to address suspected red flags in the P7.2 trillion budget bill passed by the House of Representatives. “Ang attitude namin sa ngayon, gung-ho. Kung masagasaan, masagasaan. Kung magbigay ng exceptions to the rule minsan ang exceptions ang nagiging general rule,” he said during an interview in One News on Friday. (Our attitude now […]...
